en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a prominent cityscape centered on a large cathedral with distinct domes, an obelisk-like monument, and a wide boulevard with a row of trees. The postcard has handwritten messages, a postage stamp with Cyrillic text, and a postmark. Printed text appears both in Cyrillic and German on the image side, indicating a greeting from Varna.
